name: TabListVertical

props.name: activation
props.description: Specify whether the content tab should be activated automatically or manually

props.name: scrollIntoView
props.description: Choose whether to automatically scroll to newly selected tabs on component rerender

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the tabs.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TabListVertical rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
